retained: S4D-Lin diagonal initialization: negative real part -0.5 and imaginary part pi*n

four residual layers with post-LayerNorm by default and optional source prenorm

shared benchmark optimization used; upstream selected-parameter LR/decay groups are not reproduced
excluded: full S4 custom kernels and non-diagonal HiPPO parameterization
S4D initialization or discretization variants beyond the fixed minimal S4D-Lin/ZOH source
pretraining, pretrained weights, auxiliary labels and selective Mamba dynamics
